title: Jaina Sutras, Part I: Acaranga Sutra and Kalpa Sutra
author: Jain canonical tradition; translated by Hermann Jacobi
source_owner: Ancient Wisdom Atlas / Hermann Jacobi edition
rights_notes: Hermann Jacobi's English translation was published in 1884 and is public domain in the United States. These are transmitted Jain canonical texts, not writings authored directly by Mahavira.
notes: Clean full-text edition of Acaranga Sutra and Kalpa Sutra. Core evidence for Mahavira's transmitted teachings and traditional biography.

title: Jaina Sutras, Part II: Uttaradhyayana Sutra and Sutrakritanga Sutra
author: Jain canonical tradition; translated by Hermann Jacobi
source_owner: Ancient Wisdom Atlas / Hermann Jacobi edition
rights_notes: Hermann Jacobi's English translation was published in 1895 and is public domain in the United States. These are transmitted Jain canonical texts, not writings authored directly by Mahavira.
notes: Clean full-text edition of Uttaradhyayana Sutra and Sutrakritanga Sutra. Core source for discipline, karma, ahimsa, right conduct, and liberation.

title: The Kalpa Sutra and Nava Tatva
author: Translated and edited by John Stevenson
rights_notes: Published in 1848 and public domain in the United States. Contains an older English translation of the Kalpa Sutra together with Nava Tatva material. Some Kalpa Sutra content overlaps with Jacobi Part I, but this edition adds a different translation and doctrinal material.
notes: Original rechat Mahavira source retained because its text quality was good. Useful for Mahavira's traditional biography and the nine tattvas; some canonical overlap with Part I is expected.

title: Outlines of Jainism
author: Jagmandarlal Jaini
rights_notes: Published in 1916 and public domain in the United States. This is secondary scholarly commentary on Jain doctrine rather than a text authored by or directly transmitted from Mahavira.
notes: Original rechat Mahavira source retained for explanatory context on Jain metaphysics, ethics, karma, cosmology, vows, and doctrinal terminology.
